title.value: The Statistical Benefits of Quantile Temporal-Difference Learning for Value Estimation
title.justification: The title is explicitly mentioned at the top of the document.
title.quote: The Statistical Benefits of Quantile Temporal-Difference Learning for Value Estimation

extractions.description: This paper studies the problem of temporal-difference-based policy evaluation in reinforcement learning using a distributional reinforcement learning algorithm called quantile temporal-difference learning (QTD). The paper demonstrates that QTD can offer performance improvements over classical temporal-difference learning (TD) in scenarios with significant stochasticity, even if the return distribution beyond the mean is not of interest. The paper includes theoretical analysis on the convergence and performance of QTD, as well as empirical studies to compare QTD with TD across different types of environments.
